dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides several concrete, non‑obvious details (Karpenter v1 API migration, consolidationPolicy budgets, specific spot‑diversification families, VPA mode pitfalls, descheduler safety caps) that a generic model would not enumerate, but much of the content restates publicly documented best‑practices, so the delta is strong but not maximal.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific reasoning (choose Karpenter vs CA, migration steps, wave‑enable pattern, pre‑flight confirmation gate) and concrete CLI/helm commands. Only minor generic phrasing (e.g., "check security") prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough NEVER list with concrete reasons (conflict between Karpenter and CA, disruption budget necessity, spot‑family diversification, HPA/VPA conflict, zero scale‑down window, etc.). One small omission: no explicit warning about using outdated Karpenter versions beyond v1.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description clearly states WHAT, WHEN, and KEYWORDS. Activation triggers and invocation schema are present. Slight vagueness in "deterministic AUTOSCALING block" wording could cause ambiguous activation.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Top‑level sections give a high‑level mindset and quick navigation before deep manifests, but the document front‑loads many detailed tables and code snippets that could overwhelm a first‑pass reader.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are gated by a mandatory confirmation step and pre‑flight checks; creative tasks have generous freedom. The only shortfall is the lack of an explicit “dry‑run only” mode for the initial deployment.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (Mindset → Navigation → Steps → Output → Anti‑patterns → Appendices). Minor inconsistency in ordering of some sections prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: The skill supplies working manifests and a clear output format, yet the model’s generated example violates an anti‑pattern (HPA scaleUp stabilizationWindowSeconds set to 0 despite guidance to avoid zero windows). This shows the skill does not enforce its own safety rules, reducing reliability.
